Subject: Post-demo security recap & IAM evidence kickoff

Hi Fiona / Jacob —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Goal: Confirm Redwood can meet Medivar's IAM and compliance requirements for production data (SSO, SCIM provisioning, RBAC, audit logging).
- High level asks you raised: SOC 2 status, HIPAA applicability, SSO (SAML) integration, SCIM for user provisioning, and admin role separation.

Next steps we propose: 
1) Medivar to share a completed vendor security questionnaire (or link to existing security portal).
2) Redwood to provide an initial IAM evidence bundle and a short implementation checklist for SSO + SCIM.
3) Align on timeline: can we target a 2-week window for the first exchange of evidence?

Ben from our security team is cc'd — he'll own the evidence pack and mapping for SCIM attributes. Priyom (solutions security) will join the thread shortly with a structured delivery plan.

Attachments: none on this message.

Best,

Thanks Vanessa — good demo and appreciate the clear next steps. 

I've attached our standard vendor security questionnaire (VSSQ). Please complete the sections on SOC 2 status, data residency controls, encryption, and identity provisioning. A few clarifications from our side: 
- HIPAA: We expect Business Associate Agreement if PHI will be processed; please flag if Redwood plans to ingest any PHI during evaluation.
- SCIM: We use SCIM v2 and map to our custom attribute "medivar:employee_type" — we'll need a head-nod on attribute mapping compatibility.
- RBAC: We need a summary of admin role separation and ability to restrict model access per-team.

Can you confirm an initial delivery date for the evidence? Preferably by Oct 14 so our security team can triage before the procurement review.

Attachments (1): Medivar_VendorSecurityQuestionnaire.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Regards,

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Fiona Kelly <fiona.kelly@medivar.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference>
Cc: Jacob Miller <jacob.miller@medivar.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo security recap & IAM evidence kickoff

Fiona — thanks for the questionnaire. We'll work through it and return the completed file. A few quick notes upfront: 

- SOC 2: Redwood completed a SOC 2 Type II audit in Q2 2026; a summary report is included in the evidence pack I will send. We can provide the full report under NDA if required.
- HIPAA: Redwood supports HIPAA-compliant deployments for customers that configure Private deployments and sign a BAA. For hosted evaluation instances, we recommend redacting PHI or using synthetic data unless a BAA is in place.
- SAML/SSO: We support SAML 2.0 integrations; common IdPs supported include Okta, Azure AD, and OneLogin. I'll include the SSO configuration checklist.
- SCIM: We support SCIM v2; default attribute set is mapped to common attributes (userName, givenName, familyName, emails). For custom attributes like medivar:employee_type we can add a mapping rule on the SCIM connector or use a custom attribute extension; I'll detail the mapping options.
- RBAC: We have role templates (admin, power-user, viewer) and per-model access controls. Fine-grained RBAC for model access can be scoped to groups synced via SCIM or mapped from IdP claims.

We plan to bundle: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, SSO-config-checklist.xlsx, SCIM-attribute-mappings.md, and an initial ID/access evidence pack. Expect first drop by EOD Oct 14. If you need faster turnaround on a specific item (e.g., SOC 2 report), tell us and we'll prioritize NDA steps.

Ben Carter
Security Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference

Hi all — following Ben's note, attaching the initial evidence bundle and a short delivery plan. Items included in the zip: 

- redwood-id-access-pack.zip (contains SSO configuration guide, SCIM mapping samples, RBAC matrix sample, admin change logs example)
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (SOC 2 Type II summary and auditor contact info)
- SSO-config-checklist.xlsx (step-by-step IdP config for Okta/Azure AD)

Delivery plan: 
1) Today (Oct 14): drop evidence bundle to Medivar security (attached).
2) Oct 15–16: technical sync (30 min) with your IdP admin + our infra engineer to walk SAML/SCIM mapping and test a SAML assertion. Please propose a time slot.
3) Oct 19: pilot provisioning test via SCIM (10–20 users) in our staging env.

Notes and asks for Medivar security team: 
- Please confirm whether you will require a signed NDA/SOC 2 access request for the full SOC 2 report.
- Share the completed questionnaire back (we'll annotate answers inline) and indicate your priority items so we can sequence deliverables.

Attachments (3): redwood-id-access-pack.zip, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, SSO-config-checklist.xlsx

—Priyom
